function v15ChoiceBlock(title,q,opts,ans,exp){

function photoActivity(idx){

 return `<div class="rjx-exercise toeic-photo-lab"><span class="rjx-visual-badge">📷 TOEIC Part 1 Photo Lab</span><h4>Study the picture carefully</h4><div class="rjx-toeic-photo real"><img src="${s.img}" alt="${esc(s.title)}"><div class="rjx-photo-caption">Scene focus: realistic people in a real situation. Practise noticing actions, objects, positions and the overall setting.</div></div><div class="rjx-guided-grid"><div class="rjx-resource"><h4>What can you see?</h4><div class="rjx-photo-focus">${s.focus.map(x=>`<div class="rjx-check">✓ ${x}</div>`).join('')}</div></div><div class="rjx-resource"><h4>Useful vocabulary</h4><div class="rjx-vocab-chips">${s.vocab.map(x=>`<span>${x}</span>`).join('')}</div></div></div>${v15ChoiceBlock('Main TOEIC-style question','Which description best matches the picture?',main,0,'<strong>Correct answer:</strong> '+s.correct+'<br>The other options are wrong because they describe a different place, activity or object that is not supported by the picture.')}${v15ChoiceBlock('Notice the setting',s.locQ[0],s.locQ[1],s.locQ[2],s.locQ[3])}${v15ChoiceBlock('Notice a key detail',s.prepQ[0],s.prepQ[1],s.prepQ[2],s.prepQ[3])}${v15ChoiceBlock('True or false?',s.tfQ[0],s.tfQ[1],s.tfQ[2],s.tfQ[3])}<div class="rjx-exercise"><h4>Guided description builder</h4><p>Use the sentence starters to describe the scene in your own words. function wireActivity(root,kind,m,idx){
 root.querySelectorAll('.rjx-question-block').forEach(block=>{
   const exp=block.querySelector('.rjx-explain');

     const ans=+b.dataset.answer, chosen=+b.dataset.v14choice; const opts=[...block.querySelectorAll('[data-v14choice]')];
     opts.forEach((x,i)=>{x.disabled=true;if(i===ans)x.classList.add('correct')}); if(chosen!==ans)b.classList.add('wrong'); if(exp)exp.classList.add('show');
   });
 });
 root.querySelectorAll('[data-v14-reveal]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{
   const model=root.querySelector('#v15Model'); if(model)model.classList.toggle('show');
   const nearest=b.closest('.rjx-question-block')?.querySelector('.rjx-explain'); if(nearest)nearest.classList.add('show');
 });
 root.querySelectorAll('[data-v14choice]').forEach(b=>{ if(b.closest('.rjx-question-block')) return; b.onclick=()=>{ const exp=root.querySelector('#v14Explain'); const ans=+b.dataset.answer, chosen=+b.dataset.v14choice; const opts=[...root.querySelectorAll('[data-v14choice]')].filter(x=>!x.closest('.rjx-question-block')); opts.forEach((x,i)=>{x.disabled=true;if(i===ans)x.classList.add('correct')}); if(chosen!==ans)b.classList.add('wrong'); if(exp)exp.classList.add('show')}});
 root.querySelectorAll('[data-v14-reveal]').forEach(b=>{ if(b.closest('.rjx-question-block')) return; b.onclick=()=>root.querySelector('#v14Explain')?.classList.add('show') });
 const checkText=root.querySelector('[data-v14-checktext]');if(checkText)checkText.onclick=()=>{const v=(root.querySelector('#v14Text')?.value||'').trim().toLowerCase();const ans=checkText.dataset.answer.toLowerCase();checkText.textContent=v===ans?'✓ Correct':'Try again / show answer';if(v===ans||v.length>1)root.querySelector('#v14Explain')?.classList.add('show')};
 let selected=null;root.querySelectorAll('.rjx-match-item').forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{if(x.classList.contains('done'))return;if(!selected){selected=x;x.classList.add('selected');return}if(selected.dataset.side!==x.dataset.side&&selected.dataset.pair===x.dataset.pair){selected.classList.remove('selected');selected.classList.add('done');x.classList.add('done');selected=null}else{selected.classList.remove('selected');selected=x;x.classList.add('selected')}});
 root.querySelectorAll('.rjx-flip').forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{const r=!x.classList.contains('revealed');x.classList.toggle('revealed',r);x.textContent=r?x.dataset.back:x.dataset.front});
 const list=root.querySelector('#v14Sort');if(list){let drag=null;list.querySelectorAll('.rjx-sort-item').forEach(x=>{x.ondragstart=()=>{drag=x;x.classList.add('dragging')};x.ondragend=()=>x.classList.remove('dragging');x.ondragover=e=>{e.preventDefault();const after=[...list.querySelectorAll('.rjx-sort-item:not(.dragging)')].find(el=>e.clientY<=el.getBoundingClientRect().top+el.offsetHeight/2);if(after)list.insertBefore(drag,after);else list.appendChild(drag)}});root.querySelector('[data-v14-checksort]').onclick=()=>{const ok=[...list.children].every((x,i)=>+x.dataset.order===i);root.querySelector('[data-v14-checksort]').textContent=ok?'✓ Correct order':'Not yet — review the model order';root.querySelector('#v14Explain')?.classList.add('show')}}
 const save=root.querySelector('[data-v14-save]');if(save)save.onclick=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem(`v14draft-${kind}-${idx}`,root.querySelector('#v14Draft').value)}catch(e){};save.textContent='✓ Saved'; const exp=root.querySelector('#v14Explain'); if(exp)exp.classList.add('show')};if(root.querySelector('#v14Draft')){try{root.querySelector('#v14Draft').value=localStorage.getItem(`v14draft-${kind}-${idx}`)||''}catch(e){}}
 let t=null;const timer=root.querySelector('#v14Timer');const set=n=>{if(timer)timer.textContent=`00:${String(n).padStart(2,'0')}`};const start=root.querySelector('[data-v14-starttimer]');if(start)start.onclick=()=>{clearInterval(t);let n=60;set(n);t=setInterval(()=>{n--;set(n);if(n<=0){clearInterval(t);timer.textContent='TIME'}},1000)};const reset=root.querySelector('[data-v14-resettimer]');if(reset)reset.onclick=()=>{clearInterval(t);set(60)};
}

function v16Extra(s){return V16_PHOTO_EXTRA[s.title]||V16_PHOTO_EXTRA["Coffee shop conversation"]}
function v16Select(title,prompt,opts,ans,feedback){return `<div class="v16-task"><h4>${title}</h4><p>${prompt}</p><div class="rjx-options">${opts.map((x,i)=>`<button class="rjx-option" data-v16-choice="${i}" data-v16-answer="${ans}">${x}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="v16-mini-feedback">${feedback}</div></div>`}
function v16Flashcards(s){const defs={barista:'a person who prepares and serves coffee',counter:'a long surface where customers are served',presenter:'a person who speaks to an audience',receptionist:'a person who welcomes and assists visitors',clipboard:'a board used to hold papers while writing',platform:'the area beside a train where passengers wait',blueprint:'a technical building plan',customer:'a person who buys goods or services',luggage:'bags and suitcases used for travel',warehouse:'a building used to store goods'};return `<div class="v16-task"><h4>Vocabulary flip cards</h4><p>Tap each card to reveal the meaning.</p><div class="v16-flips">${s.vocab.slice(0,6).map(w=>`<div class="v16-flip" data-front="${esc(w)}" data-back="${esc(defs[w]||('Useful word for this '+s.title.toLowerCase()+' scene'))}">${w}</div>`).join('')}</div></div>`}
function v16DragSort(s,e){const labels=[{text:s.focus[0],target:'people'},{text:e.object,target:'object'},{text:s.title,target:'place'}];return `<div class="v16-task"><h4>Drag-and-drop labels</h4><p>Match each label to the part of the picture it describes.</p><div class="v16-label-bank">${labels.map(x=>`<span class="v16-drag" draggable="true" data-v16-drag="${esc(x.text)}" data-v16-target="${x.target}">${x.text}</span>`).join('')}</div><div class="v16-drop-wrap" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)"><div class="v16-drop-zone" data-v16-drop="people"><strong>People / action</strong></div><div class="v16-drop-zone" data-v16-drop="object"><strong>Object</strong></div><div class="v16-drop-zone" data-v16-drop="place"><strong>Scene / place</strong></div></div><div class="v16-mini-feedback">Excellent — you matched the people/action, object and scene correctly.</div></div>`}
function v16SentenceBuild(e){const shuffled=[...e.parts].map((x,i)=>({x,i})).sort((a,b)=>((b.i*7+3)%11)-((a.i*7+3)%11));return `<div class="v16-task"><h4>Build the sentence</h4><p>Tap the chunks in the correct order.</p><div class="v16-sentence" data-v16-built data-v16-target="${esc(e.parts.join(' '))}"></div><div class="v16-build-bank">${shuffled.map(o=>`<button class="v16-word" data-v16-word="${esc(o.x)}" data-v16-order="${o.i}">${o.x}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="rjx-actions"><button class="rjx-btn" data-v16-checksentence>Check sentence</button><button class="rjx-btn" data-v16-resetsentence>Reset</button></div><div class="v16-mini-feedback" data-v16-sentencefeedback>Correct — the sentence is natural and accurate.</div></div>`}
function photoActivity(idx){
 const s=v15PhotoScene(idx),e=v16Extra(s),main=[s.correct,...s.wrong];
 return `<div class="rjx-exercise toeic-photo-lab"><span class="rjx-visual-badge">📷 TOEIC Part 1 · Interactive Photo Lab</span><h4>${s.title}</h4><div class="rjx-toeic-photo real"><img src="${s.img}" alt="${esc(s.title)}"><div class="rjx-photo-caption">Look closely at people, actions, objects, positions and the overall setting before answering.</div></div><div class="rjx-guided-grid"><div class="rjx-resource"><h4>What can you see?</h4><div class="rjx-photo-focus">${s.focus.map(x=>`<div class="rjx-check">✓ ${x}</div>`).join('')}</div></div><div class="rjx-resource"><h4>Useful scene vocabulary</h4><div class="rjx-vocab-chips">${s.vocab.map(x=>`<span>${x}</span>`).join('')}</div></div></div>${v15ChoiceBlock('1. Main TOEIC-style question','Which description best matches the picture?',main,0,'<strong>Correct:</strong> '+s.correct+'<br>Each distractor describes something that is not visible or does not match the main action.')}${v15ChoiceBlock('2. Notice the setting',s.locQ[0],s.locQ[1],s.locQ[2],s.locQ[3])}${v15ChoiceBlock('3. Notice a key detail',s.prepQ[0],s.prepQ[1],s.prepQ[2],s.prepQ[3])}${v15ChoiceBlock('4. True or false?',s.tfQ[0],s.tfQ[1],s.tfQ[2],s.tfQ[3])}<div class="v16-grid">${v16Select('5. Choose the correct action','Which verb best describes the main action?',e.verb,0,'Correct — this verb accurately describes what is happening in the picture.')}${v16Select('6. Choose the correct preposition','Which preposition or phrase best fits this scene?',e.prep,0,'Correct — this location phrase matches the position shown in the image.')}<div class="v16-task"><h4>7. Fill in the blank</h4><p>${e.blank}</p><input class="rjx-input" data-v16-gap placeholder="Type the missing word or phrase"><button class="rjx-btn primary" data-v16-checkgap data-answer="${esc(e.blankAns)}" style="margin-top:8px">Check answer</button><div class="v16-mini-feedback">Correct answer: <strong>${e.blankAns}</strong></div></div>${v16Flashcards(s)}${v16DragSort(s,e)}${v16SentenceBuild(e)}<div class="v16-task"><h4>10. Find and correct the mistake</h4><p><strong>Wrong:</strong> ${e.mistake}</p><textarea class="rjx-input" data-v16-correction placeholder="Rewrite the idea correctly..."></textarea><button class="rjx-btn" data-v16-showcorrection style="margin-top:8px">Show coaching note</button><div class="v16-mini-feedback">The note above explains the grammar or word-choice issue. Use it to rewrite the sentence naturally.</div></div><div class="v16-task"><h4>11. }
function v16WireExtra(root){
 root.querySelectorAll('[data-v16-choice]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const box=b.closest('.v16-task'),ans=+b.dataset.v16Answer,chosen=+b.dataset.v16Choice;box.querySelectorAll('[data-v16-choice]').forEach((x,i)=>{x.disabled=true;if(i===ans)x.classList.add('correct')});if(chosen!==ans)b.classList.add('wrong');box.querySelector('.v16-mini-feedback')?.classList.add('show')});
 root.querySelectorAll('[data-v16-checkgap]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{const box=b.closest('.v16-task'),val=(box.querySelector('[data-v16-gap]').value||'').trim().toLowerCase(),ans=b.dataset.answer.toLowerCase();if(val===ans){b.textContent='✓ Correct';box.querySelector('.v16-mini-feedback')?.classList.add('show')}else{b.textContent='Try again'}});
 root.querySelectorAll('.v16-flip').forEach(x=>x.onclick=()=>{const on=!x.classList.contains('revealed');x.classList.toggle('revealed',on);x.textContent=on?x.dataset.back:x.dataset.front});
 let dragging=null;root.querySelectorAll('[data-v16-drag]').forEach(x=>x.ondragstart=()=>dragging=x);root.querySelectorAll('[data-v16-drop]').forEach(z=>{z.ondragover=e=>e.preventDefault();z.ondrop=e=>{e.preventDefault();if(!dragging)return;if(dragging.dataset.v16Target===z.dataset.v16Drop){z.appendChild(dragging);z.classList.add('good');dragging=null;const task=z.closest('.v16-task');const remaining=task.querySelectorAll('.v16-label-bank [data-v16-drag]').length;if(remaining===0)task.querySelector('.v16-mini-feedback')?.classList.add('show')}else{z.animate([{transform:'translateX(0)'},{transform:'translateX(-6px)'},{transform:'translateX(6px)'},{transform:'translateX(0)'}],{duration:220});dragging=null}}});
 root.querySelectorAll('.v16-task').forEach(box=>{const built=box.querySelector('[data-v16-built]');if(!built)return;const words=box.querySelectorAll('[data-v16-word]');words.forEach(w=>w.onclick=()=>{if(w.disabled)return;const s=document.createElement('span');s.textContent=w.dataset.v16Word+' ';s.dataset.chunk=w.dataset.v16Word;s.dataset.order=w.dataset.v16Order;built.appendChild(s);w.disabled=true});box.querySelector('[data-v16-checksentence]').onclick=()=>{const order=[...built.querySelectorAll('span')].map(x=>+x.dataset.order);const correct=order.length===words.length && order.every((n,i)=>n===i);if(correct){box.querySelector('[data-v16-sentencefeedback]')?.classList.add('show');box.querySelector('[data-v16-checksentence]').textContent='✓ Correct'}else{box.querySelector('[data-v16-checksentence]').textContent='Not quite — reset and try again'}};box.querySelector('[data-v16-resetsentence]').onclick=()=>{built.innerHTML='';words.forEach(w=>w.disabled=false);box.querySelector('[data-v16-sentencefeedback]')?.classList.remove('show');box.querySelector('[data-v16-checksentence]').textContent='Check sentence'}});
 root.querySelectorAll('[data-v16-showcorrection]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>b.closest('.v16-task').querySelector('.v16-mini-feedback')?.classList.add('show'));
}

wireActivity=function(root,kind,m,idx){V15_WIRE_ACTIVITY(root,kind,m,idx);v16WireExtra(root)};

function e(v){return String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]))}
function storeGet(k){try{return localStorage.getItem(k)}catch(x){return null}} function storeSet(k,v){try{localStorage.setItem(k,v)}catch(x){}}

// Dictionary route + page.
const internal=document.getElementById('rjxInternal');
if(!document.getElementById('rjxDictionary')){const s=document.createElement('section');s.className='rjx-page';s.id='rjxDictionary';s.innerHTML='<div class="rjx-hero"><div class="rjx-hero-in"><div class="rjx-kicker">DICTIONARY</div><h1>Look up words. <span>Hear British English.</span></h1><p>Definitions, examples, pronunciation, synonyms and a saved vocabulary list.</p></div></div><div class="rjx-wrap" id="rjxDictionaryBody"></div>';internal.appendChild(s)}
pageMap.dictionary='rjxDictionary';
const oldSetNav=setNav; setNav=function(route){oldSetNav(route); if(route==='dictionary'){nav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a=>a.classList.remove('active'));nav.querySelector('a[href="#dictionary"]')?.classList.add('active')}};
const oldRenderRoute=renderRoute; renderRoute=function(r){if(r==='dictionary')return renderDictionary();return oldRenderRoute(r)};
if(!nav.querySelector('a[href="#dictionary"]')){const a=document.createElement('a');a.href='#dictionary';a.textContent='Dictionary';const contact=nav.querySelector('a[href="#contact"]');nav.insertBefore(a,contact);a.onclick=x=>{x.preventDefault();show('dictionary')}}

const MINI={fluent:{phonetic:'/ˈfluː.ənt/',def:'able to speak or write smoothly and easily',ex:'She became fluent after using English every day.'},coherent:{phonetic:'/kəʊˈhɪə.rənt/',def:'clear, logical and easy to understand',ex:'His answer was coherent and well organised.'},sustainable:{phonetic:'/səˈsteɪ.nə.bəl/',def:'able to continue without causing serious environmental or social harm',ex:'The city is investing in sustainable transport.'},deadline:{phonetic:'/ˈded.laɪn/',def:'the latest time by which something must be completed',ex:'The project deadline is Friday.'},negotiate:{phonetic:'/nɪˈɡəʊ.ʃi.eɪt/',def:'to discuss something in order to reach an agreement',ex:'They negotiated a better contract.'},itinerary:{phonetic:'/aɪˈtɪn.ər.ər.i/',def:'a detailed plan for a journey',ex:'The itinerary includes two days in Bangkok.'}};
function speakBritish(text,voiceName,rate=.92){if(!('speechSynthesis'in window)||!text)return;const vs=speechSynthesis.getVoices();const rank=v=>{let n=0;if(/^en-GB$/i.test(v.lang))n+=100;const x=v.name.toLowerCase();if(/sonia|ryan|libby|google uk english|daniel|kate|serena|martha|arthur/.test(x))n+=60;if(v.localService===false)n+=5;return n};let v=voiceName?vs.find(x=>x.name===voiceName):null;if(!v)v=[...vs].sort((a,b)=>rank(b)-rank(a))[0];speechSynthesis.cancel();const u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(text);u.lang='en-GB';if(v)u.voice=v;u.rate=rate;u.pitch=1;speechSynthesis.speak(u)}
window.rjxSpeakBritish=speakBritish;
function britishVoices(){return ('speechSynthesis'in window)?speechSynthesis.getVoices().filter(v=>/^en(-GB)?/i.test(v.lang)):[]}
function renderDictionary(){const root=document.getElementById('rjxDictionaryBody');root.innerHTML=`<div class="rjx-card"><div class="rjx-tag">RJ WORD FINDER</div><h2>English Dictionary</h2><p>Search a word for definitions, examples, pronunciation and synonyms.</p><div class="rjx-dict-search"><input class="rjx-input" id="dictWord" placeholder="Type a word, e.g. coherent"><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="dictGo">Search →</button></div><div id="dictStatus" class="rjx-dict-result"></div></div><div class="rjx-card" style="margin-top:16px"><h3>Saved vocabulary</h3><div id="dictSaved"></div></div>`;const input=document.getElementById('dictWord'),box=document.getElementById('dictStatus');function saved(){let a=[];try{a=JSON.parse(storeGet('rjxSavedWords')||'[]')}catch(x){};document.getElementById('dictSaved').innerHTML=a.length?`<div class="rjx-syns">${a.map(w=>`<span>${e(w)}</span>`).join('')}</div>`:'<p>No saved words yet.</p>'}saved();async function go(){const word=input.value.trim().toLowerCase();if(!word)return;box.innerHTML='<p>Looking up the word…</p>';let data=null;try{const r=await fetch('https://api.dictionaryapi.dev/api/v2/entries/en/'+encodeURIComponent(word));if(r.ok)data=(await r.json())[0]}catch(x){};if(data){const m=(data.meanings||[])[0],d=(m?.definitions||[])[0],phon=data.phonetic||(data.phonetics||[]).find(x=>x.text)?.text||'';const syn=[...(m?.synonyms||[]),...(d?.synonyms||[])].slice(0,10);box.innerHTML=`<div class="rjx-dict-word">${e(data.word)}</div><div class="rjx-phonetic">${e(phon)}</div><p><strong>${e(m?.partOfSpeech||'word')}</strong> · ${e(d?.definition||'Definition unavailable.')}</p>${d?.example?`<div class="rjx-task">${e(d.example)}</div>`:''}<div class="rjx-syns">${syn.map(x=>`<span>${e(x)}</span>`).join('')}</div><div class="rjx-actions" style="margin-top:12px"><button class="rjx-btn" id="dictHear">🔊 Hear British pronunciation</button><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="dictSave">Save word</button></div>`}else if(MINI[word]){const d=MINI[word];box.innerHTML=`<div class="rjx-dict-word">${e(word)}</div><div class="rjx-phonetic">${e(d.phonetic)}</div><p>${e(d.def)}</p><div class="rjx-task">${e(d.ex)}</div><div class="rjx-actions" style="margin-top:12px"><button class="rjx-btn" id="dictHear">🔊 Hear British pronunciation</button><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="dictSave">Save word</button></div>`}else{box.innerHTML='<div class="rjx-feedback show">I could not find that word. Check the spelling or try another form of the word.</div>'}document.getElementById('dictHear')?.addEventListener('click',()=>speakBritish(word));document.getElementById('dictSave')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{let a=[];try{a=JSON.parse(storeGet('rjxSavedWords')||'[]')}catch(x){};if(!a.includes(word))a.unshift(word);a=a.slice(0,50);storeSet('rjxSavedWords',JSON.stringify(a));saved()})}document.getElementById('dictGo').onclick=go;input.onkeydown=x=>{if(x.key==='Enter')go()}}

// Rich IELTS tools layered on top of the existing 100-lesson centre.
const oldExam=window.renderExamCentre;
function injectIELTSTools(root,sec){if(sec!=='ielts'||!root.querySelector('#v14Cue')||root.querySelector('#v18P3'))return;const grid=root.querySelector('.rjx-section-grid');if(!grid)return;grid.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<div class="rjx-section-card" id="v18P3"><div class="emoji">💬</div><h3>Speaking Part 3 Lab</h3><p>30 discussion topics and 120 deeper questions with vocabulary, model development and speaking practice.</p><span class="rjx-link">Open Part 3 Lab →</span></div><div class="rjx-section-card" id="v18Mock"><div class="emoji">🎤</div><h3>Full Speaking Mock</h3><p>Practise Parts 1, 2 and 3 in one connected speaking journey.</p><span class="rjx-link">Start speaking mock →</span></div><div class="rjx-section-card" id="v18Band"><div class="emoji">📊</div><h3>IELTS Test Map & Band Coach</h3><p>Official structure, timing, question types and assessment criteria in one interactive guide.</p><span class="rjx-link">Open IELTS guide →</span></div><div class="rjx-section-card" id="v18Write"><div class="emoji">📝</div><h3>Writing Planner Lab</h3><p>Task 1 and Task 2 planning, thesis building, paragraph structure and saved drafts.</p><span class="rjx-link">Open writing lab →</span></div>`);document.getElementById('v18P3').onclick=()=>renderP3(root);document.getElementById('v18Mock').onclick=()=>renderMock(root);document.getElementById('v18Band').onclick=()=>renderBand(root);document.getElementById('v18Write').onclick=()=>renderWritingLab(root)}
function v18Exam(root,sec){oldExam(root,sec);injectIELTSTools(root,sec)} window.renderExamCentre=v18Exam;try{renderExamCentre=v18Exam}catch(x){}
function backIELTS(root){v18Exam(root,'ielts');window.scrollTo(0,0)}
function p3Model(topic,q){return `A strong way to approach this is to answer the question directly, then explain the main reason. For ${topic.toLowerCase()}, I would avoid making an absolute claim. Instead, I would compare different situations and give a concrete example. That makes the answer easier to follow and gives me a chance to use more precise vocabulary and a wider range of grammar.`}
function renderP3(root){let page=0,sel=null;const draw=()=>{if(sel!==null)return detail(sel);const start=page*10,items=P3.slice(start,start+10);root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb('IELTS Speaking Part 3')+`<div class="rjx-exam-hero"><div class="rjx-tag" style="background:#fff;color:#07172f">SPEAKING PART 3</div><h2>Discussion & Abstract Ideas Lab</h2><p>Part 3 develops the Part 2 topic into a more detailed discussion. Practise explaining reasons, comparing situations, discussing causes and consequences, and evaluating ideas.</p><div class="rjx-exam-stats"><span class="rjx-exam-stat">30 topics</span><span class="rjx-exam-stat">120 questions</span><span class="rjx-exam-stat">Band 7–9 language support</span></div></div><div class="rjx-grid2">${items.map((x,i)=>`<div class="rjx-card click" data-p3="${start+i}"><div class="rjx-tag">TOPIC ${start+i+1}</div><h3>${e(x[0])}</h3><p>${e(x[1][0])}</p><span class="rjx-link">Open discussion →</span></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="rjx-bottom-nav">${page>0?'<button class="rjx-btn" id="p3Prev">← Previous 10</button>':'<span></span>'}<span>Page ${page+1} of 3</span>${page<2?'<button class="rjx-btn primary" id="p3Next">Next 10 →</button>':'<span class="rjx-chip">FINAL PAGE ✓</span>'}</div><div style="margin-top:10px"><button class="rjx-btn" id="p3Back">← IELTS Centre</button></div>`;root.querySelectorAll('[data-p3]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{sel=+b.dataset.p3;draw()});document.getElementById('p3Prev')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{page--;draw()});document.getElementById('p3Next')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{page++;draw()});document.getElementById('p3Back').onclick=()=>backIELTS(root)};const detail=i=>{const t=P3[i];root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb('Speaking Part 3 · '+t[0])+`<div class="rjx-toolbar"><strong>Topic ${i+1} of ${P3.length} · ${e(t[0])}</strong><button class="rjx-btn" id="p3Topics">← All topics</button></div><div class="rjx-lab-shell"><main><div class="rjx-card"><h2>${e(t[0])}</h2><p>Answer naturally. Aim for: <strong>position → reason → example → wider consequence or comparison.</strong></p><div class="rjx-syns">${t[2].map(v=>`<span>${e(v)}</span>`).join('')}</div></div>${t[1].map((q,qi)=>`<div class="rjx-question-card"><div class="rjx-tag">QUESTION ${qi+1}</div><h3>${e(q)}</h3><div class="rjx-actions"><button class="rjx-btn" data-hear="${qi}">🔊 Hear question</button><button class="rjx-btn" data-mic="${qi}">🎙 Dictate answer</button></div><textarea class="rjx-textarea" id="p3a${qi}" placeholder="Develop your answer here..."></textarea>${qi===0?`<button class="rjx-btn" data-model="0">Show model development</button><div class="rjx-model-answer" id="p3model">${e(p3Model(t[0],q))}</div>`:''}</div>`).join('')}</main><aside class="rjx-card"><h3>Part 3 answer builder</h3><div class="rjx-checklist"><div class="rjx-check">1. Give a clear answer</div><div class="rjx-check">2. Explain why</div><div class="rjx-check">3. Give an example</div><div class="rjx-check">4. Compare or discuss a consequence</div></div><h3>Self-check</h3><div class="rjx-mastery">${['Fluency','Vocabulary','Grammar range','Pronunciation'].map(x=>`<button>${x}</button>`).join('')}</div><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="p3Done" style="width:100%;margin-top:14px">Mark topic complete</button></aside></div><div class="rjx-bottom-nav">${i>0?'<button class="rjx-btn" id="p3OnePrev">← Previous topic</button>':'<span></span>'}<span>Topic ${i+1} of ${P3.length}</span>${i<P3.length-1?'<button class="rjx-btn primary" id="p3OneNext">Next topic →</button>':'<span class="rjx-chip">FINAL TOPIC ✓</span>'}</div>`;document.getElementById('p3Topics').onclick=()=>{sel=null;page=Math.floor(i/10);draw()};root.querySelectorAll('[data-hear]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>speakBritish(t[1][+b.dataset.hear]));root.querySelectorAll('[data-mic]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>dictate(document.getElementById('p3a'+b.dataset.mic)));root.querySelector('[data-model]')?.addEventListener('click',()=>document.getElementById('p3model').classList.toggle('show'));root.querySelectorAll('.rjx-mastery button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>b.classList.toggle('on'));document.getElementById('p3Done').onclick=()=>{markDone('ielts-part3-'+i);document.getElementById('p3Done').textContent='✓ Topic completed'};document.getElementById('p3OnePrev')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{sel=i-1;draw();scrollTo(0,0)});document.getElementById('p3OneNext')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{sel=i+1;draw();scrollTo(0,0)})};draw()}
function dictate(el){const SR=window.SpeechRecognition||window.webkitSpeechRecognition;if(!SR){alert('Speech recognition is not available in this browser. You can still type your answer.');return}const r=new SR();r.lang='en-GB';r.interimResults=false;r.onresult=x=>{el.value+=(el.value?' ':'')+x.results[0][0].transcript};r.start()}
function renderMock(root){let mi=0,part=1;function draw(){const m=MOCKS[mi];if(part===1){root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb('IELTS Speaking Mock')+`<div class="rjx-card"><div class="rjx-tag">${e(m.name)} · if(part===2){root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb('IELTS Speaking Mock')+`<div class="rjx-cue-card"><div class="rjx-cue-top"><div class="rjx-tag" style="background:#fff;color:#07172f">${e(m.name)} · PART 2</div><h2>${e(m.p2)}</h2></div><div class="rjx-cue-body"><h3>You should say:</h3>${m.bullets.map(x=>`<div class="rjx-cue-bullet">• ${e(x)}</div>`).join('')}<div class="rjx-timer-grid" id="mockNext" style="margin-top:14px">Continue to Part 3 →</button></div></div>`;wireTimers(root);document.getElementById('mockNext').onclick=()=>{part=3;draw()}}else{root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb('IELTS Speaking Mock')+`<div class="rjx-card"><div class="rjx-tag">${e(m.name)} · PART 3</div><h2>Two-way discussion</h2>${m.p3.map((q,i)=>`<div class="rjx-question-card"><h3>${e(q)}</h3><button class="rjx-btn" data-q="${i}">🔊 Hear mock</button></div></div>`;root.querySelectorAll('[data-q]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>speakBritish(m.p3[+b.dataset.q]));document.getElementById('mockDone').onclick=()=>{markDone('ielts-speaking-mock-'+mi);document.getElementById('mockDone').textContent='✓ function wireTimers(root){let timer=null;root.querySelectorAll('[data-t]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{clearInterval(timer);let n=+b.dataset.t,el=document.getElementById(n===60?'mPrep':'mSpeak');const p=()=>el.textContent=`${String(Math.floor(n/60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(n%60).padStart(2,'0')}`;p();timer=setInterval(()=>{n--;p();if(n<=0){clearInterval(timer);el.textContent='TIME'}},1000)})}
function renderBand(root){root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb('IELTS Test Map & Band Coach')+`<div class="rjx-exam-hero"><div class="rjx-tag" style="background:#fff;color:#07172f">IELTS FORMAT</div><h2>Know exactly what the test asks you to do</h2><p>Use this map before practising so each activity connects to the real test structure.</p></div><div class="rjx-tool-grid"><div class="rjx-tool-card"><h3>🎧 Listening</h3><p><strong>4 parts · 40 questions.</strong> Everyday social situations in Parts 1–2, educational/training contexts in Parts 3–4. Recordings are heard once.</p></div><div class="rjx-tool-card"><h3>📖 Reading</h3><p><strong>60 minutes · 3 sections · 40 questions.</strong> Academic and General Training use different reading material.</p></div><div class="rjx-tool-card"><h3>✍️ Writing</h3><p><strong>60 minutes · 2 tasks.</strong> Academic Task 1 uses visual information; Task 2 is an essay. Task 2 carries more weight.</p></div><div class="rjx-tool-card"><h3>🎙 Speaking</h3><p><strong>11–14 minutes · 3 parts.</strong> Part 1 familiar questions, Part 2 long turn after one minute preparation, Part 3 deeper discussion.</p></div></div><div class="rjx-card" style="margin-top:16px"><h2>Speaking self-check</h2><p>The four assessment areas are fluency & coherence, lexical resource, grammatical range & accuracy, and pronunciation.</p><div class="rjx-mastery">${['Fluency & coherence','Lexical resource','Grammar range & accuracy','Pronunciation'].map(x=>`<button>${x}</button>`).join('')}</div><h2 style="margin-top:20px">Writing self-check</h2><div class="rjx-mastery">${['Task achievement / response','Coherence & cohesion','Lexical resource','Grammar range & accuracy'].map(x=>`<button>${x}</button>`).join('')}</div><p class="rjx-official-note">Use these as study checkpoints, not as an official band score calculator.</p></div><button class="rjx-btn" id="bandBack" style="margin-top:12px">← IELTS Centre</button>`;root.querySelectorAll('.rjx-mastery button').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>b.classList.toggle('on'));document.getElementById('bandBack').onclick=()=>backIELTS(root)}
function renderWritingLab(root){const tasks=['Some people believe working from home is beneficial for employees and employers. To what extent do you agree?','Many cities are becoming more expensive to live in. What problems does this cause and what solutions can you suggest?','Some people think schools should teach practical life skills as well as academic subjects. Discuss both views and give your opinion.'];let i=0;function draw(){root.innerHTML=sectionCrumb('IELTS Writing Planner')+`<div class="rjx-card"><div class="rjx-tag">TASK 2 PLANNER · QUESTION ${i+1}</div><h2>${e(tasks[i])}</h2><div class="rjx-grid2"><div><h3>1. Position / thesis</h3><textarea class="rjx-textarea" id="w1" placeholder="Write your position in one or two clear sentences..."></textarea><h3>2. Main idea 1 + example</h3><textarea class="rjx-textarea" id="w2"></textarea></div><div><h3>3. Main idea 2 + example</h3><textarea class="rjx-textarea" id="w3"></textarea><h3>4. Counterpoint / qualification</h3><textarea class="rjx-textarea" id="w4"></textarea></div></div><div class="rjx-actions"><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="wSave">Save plan</button><button class="rjx-btn" id="wNext">Next question →</button></div></div><div class="rjx-card" style="margin-top:14px"><h3>Task 1 reminder</h3><p>Academic Task 1 requires you to select and report the main features of visual information such as graphs, charts, tables or processes. Practise choosing key features rather than describing every detail.</p><div class="rjx-checklist"><div class="rjx-check">✓ Clear overview</div><div class="rjx-check">✓ Key comparisons</div><div class="rjx-check">✓ Accurate data language</div><div class="rjx-check">✓ No unsupported opinions</div></div></div><button class="rjx-btn" id="wBack" style="margin-top:12px">← IELTS Centre</button>`;['w1','w2','w3','w4'].forEach(k=>document.getElementById(k).value=storeGet('ielts-plan-'+i+'-'+k)||'');document.getElementById('wSave').onclick=()=>{['w1','w2','w3','w4'].forEach(k=>storeSet('ielts-plan-'+i+'-'+k,document.getElementById(k).value));document.getElementById('wSave').textContent='✓ Plan saved'};document.getElementById('wNext').onclick=()=>{i=(i+1)%tasks.length;draw()};document.getElementById('wBack').onclick=()=>backIELTS(root)}draw()}

// Better AI teacher: British voice selector + richer modes + browser AI when available.

class="rjx-ai-chatbox"><div class="rjx-chat" id="aiChat"><div class="rjx-bubble bot">${e(last)}</div></div><div class="rjx-chat-compose"><input class="rjx-input" id="aiInput" placeholder="Type your English here..."><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="aiSend">Send</button></div><div class="rjx-ai-tools"><button class="rjx-btn" id="aiMic">🎙 Speak</button><button class="rjx-btn" id="aiRepeat">↻ Repeat reply</button><button class="rjx-btn" id="aiStop">■ Stop voice</button></div></div></div>`;wireCrumbs(root);const chat=document.getElementById('aiChat'),input=document.getElementById('aiInput'),status=document.getElementById('aiStatus'),sel=document.getElementById('voiceSelect'),rate=document.getElementById('voiceRate');function loadVoices(){const vs=britishVoices();sel.innerHTML=vs.length?vs.map(v=>`<option value="${e(v.name)}">${e(v.name)} · ${e(v.lang)}</option>`).join(''):'<option value="">Default English voice</option>';const names=[...sel.options].map(x=>x.value.toLowerCase());const preferred=['microsoft sonia','microsoft ryan','google uk english female','google uk english male','libby','daniel','serena','kate'];let ix=-1;for(const p of preferred){ix=names.findIndex(n=>n.includes(p));if(ix>=0)break}if(ix>=0)sel.selectedIndex=ix}loadVoices();if('speechSynthesis'in window)speechSynthesis.onvoiceschanged=loadVoices;const say=t=>{if(voiceOn)speakBritish(t,sel.value,+rate.value)};function local(m,v){const wc=v.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length;if(m==='IELTS Speaking')return wc<30?'Build this further: answer directly, explain why, give a specific example, then add a comparison or consequence. Try again with four connected sentences.':'Good development. Now improve precision: replace one general word with a stronger collocation and add one complex sentence naturally.';if(m==='IELTS Writing')return 'For IELTS Writing, check four things: task response, paragraph logic, precise vocabulary, and grammar range. Rewrite one sentence so the position or main idea is clearer.';if(m==='Pronunciation')return 'Use British English stress and rhythm: identify the important content words, reduce weaker function words, and repeat the sentence slowly before saying it naturally. Use Repeat reply to hear the model voice.';if(m==='TOEIC')return 'Keep the response practical and workplace-focused. Identify the situation, key action, location language and the detail that rules out distractors.';if(m==='Grammar')return 'Check verb form, subject–verb agreement, articles and word order. Rewrite the sentence once accurately, then make a second example with the same pattern.';if(m==='Sentence Correction')return 'I will focus on correction. Check grammar, natural word choice, punctuation and word order. Rewrite the sentence accurately, then explain the main correction in one short note.';if(m==='Vocabulary')return 'Choose one broad word and replace it with something more precise. Then use the stronger word in a natural collocation.';return wc<10?'Good start. Add a reason, a specific detail and one example so the answer sounds more natural.':'Good. Now extend the idea with one consequence, contrast or example.'}async function init(){let model='guided';try{if(window.LanguageModel?.create){const av=await LanguageModel.availability?.();if(av!=='unavailable'){session=await LanguageModel.create({systemPrompt:'You are RJ AI Teacher, a British English tutor. Give concise, accurate corrections and interactive practice. For IELTS, use the official four speaking criteria and writing criteria as guidance without pretending to award an official band score. Always give a clear next action.'});model='on-device AI'}}}catch(x){}status.innerHTML=`<strong>${model==='on-device AI'?'On-device AI available':'Guided tutor active'}.</strong> ${britishVoices().length?'British voice options found.':'Using the device default voice if available.'} ${(window.SpeechRecognition||window.webkitSpeechRecognition)?'Microphone ready.':'Microphone dictation unavailable.'}`}init();function bubble(cls,t){chat.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<div class="rjx-bubble ${cls}">${e(t)}</div>`);chat.scrollTop=chat.scrollHeight}async function send(){const v=input.value.trim();if(!v||busy)return;bubble('user',v);input.value='';busy=true;let reply='';try{reply=session?await session.prompt(`Mode: ${mode}. Learner: ${v}`):local(mode,v)}catch(x){reply=local(mode,v)}last=reply;bubble('bot',reply);say(reply);busy=false}document.querySelectorAll('[data-mode]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{mode=b.dataset.mode;document.querySelectorAll('[data-mode]').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x===b))});document.getElementById('aiSend').onclick=send;input.onkeydown=x=>{if(x.key==='Enter'){x.preventDefault();send()}};document.getElementById('aiMic').onclick=()=>dictate(input);document.getElementById('aiRepeat').onclick=()=>say(last);document.getElementById('aiStop')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{if('speechSynthesis'in window)speechSynthesis.cancel()});document.getElementById('voicePreview').onclick=()=>say('Hello. Welcome to RJ Language Academy. Let’s practise natural British English together.');document.getElementById('aiVoice').onclick=()=>{voiceOn=!voiceOn;document.getElementById('aiVoice').textContent=voiceOn?'🔊 Voice on':'🔇 Voice off';if(!voiceOn&&'speechSynthesis'in window)speechSynthesis.cancel()}}
try{renderAI=renderAI18}catch(x){} window.renderAI=renderAI18;

// Upgrade member module and A1-C2 lesson interaction without inflating lesson counts again.
const oldGen=window.renderGenericDetail||renderGenericDetail;function upgradeFactory(root,sec,index){const body=root.querySelector('.rjx-lesson-body');if(!body||body.querySelector('.rjx-activity-factory'))return;const type=index%5;const title=root.querySelector('.rjx-lesson h2')?.textContent||'this topic';let block='';if(type===0)block=`<h3>Sentence repair</h3><p>Correct this sentence and explain the mistake:</p><div class="rjx-task">She don't usually discuss ${e(title.toLowerCase())} at work.</div><textarea class="rjx-input" data-prod placeholder="Write the corrected sentence..."></textarea>`;if(type===1)block=`<h3>Build the sentence</h3><p>Tap the words in the best order.</p><div class="rjx-builder-bank">${['I','can','use','this','language','confidently'].map(x=>`<button data-word="${x}">${x}</button>`).join('')}</div><div class="rjx-builder-answer" id="memberBuild"></div><button class="rjx-btn" id="memberCheck">Check sentence</button><div class="rjx-feedback" id="memberFb"></div>`;if(type===2)block=`<h3>60-second production challenge</h3><p>Speak or write continuously about <strong>${e(title)}</strong>. Give a reason, detail and example.</p><div class="rjx-timer" id="memberTimer">01:00</div><button class="rjx-btn" id="memberStart">Start timer</button><textarea class="rjx-input" data-prod placeholder="Optional notes..."></textarea>`;if(type===3)block=`<h3>Prove It & Skip It</h3><p>If you already know this topic, prove it by producing two accurate examples and one question.</p><textarea class="rjx-input" data-prod placeholder="Example 1\nExample 2\nQuestion"></textarea><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="memberProve">Mark mastery attempt</button>`;if(type===4)block=`<h3>Real-life transfer</h3><p>Use <strong>${e(title)}</strong> in a realistic message, conversation, email or explanation.</p><textarea class="rjx-input" data-prod placeholder="Create your own real-life example..."></textarea>`;body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',`<div class="rjx-activity-factory"><div class="rjx-tag">ENGLISH ACTIVITY FACTORY</div>${block}<div class="rjx-actions" style="margin-top:12px"><button class="rjx-btn primary" id="factoryDone">Save & mark activity complete</button></div></div>`);let built=[];body.querySelectorAll('[data-word]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{built.push(b.dataset.word);document.getElementById('memberBuild').textContent=built.join(' ');b.disabled=true});document.getElementById('memberCheck')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{const ok=built.join(' ')==='I can use this language confidently';const f=document.getElementById('memberFb');f.textContent=ok?'✓ Correct sentence':'Not quite. Reset the module and try the order again.';f.classList.add('show')});let timer=null;document.getElementById('memberStart')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{clearInterval(timer);let n=60,el=document.getElementById('memberTimer');timer=setInterval(()=>{n--;el.textContent=`00:${String(n).padStart(2,'0')}`;if(n<=0){clearInterval(timer);el.textContent='TIME'}},1000)});document.getElementById('memberProve')?.addEventListener('click',()=>{markDone('prove-'+sec+'-'+index);document.getElementById('memberProve').textContent='✓ Mastery attempt saved'});document.getElementById('factoryDone').onclick=()=>{const prod=body.querySelector('[data-prod]')?.value||'';storeSet('member-prod-'+sec+'-'+index,prod);markDone('member-factory-'+sec+'-'+index);document.getElementById('factoryDone').textContent='✓ Activity saved'};const prod=body.querySelector('[data-prod]');if(prod)prod.value=storeGet('member-prod-'+sec+'-'+index)||''}
function gen18(root,sec,index){oldGen(root,sec,index);upgradeFactory(root,sec,index)}try{renderGenericDetail=gen18}catch(x){}window.renderGenericDetail=gen18;
const oldLesson=window.renderLessonDetail||renderLessonDetail;function lesson18(root){oldLesson(root);upgradeFactory(root,'academy-'+state.lesson.level,state.lesson.index)}try{renderLessonDetail=lesson18}catch(x){}window.renderLessonDetail=lesson18;
const v18OldMemberLessons=renderMemberLessons;renderMemberLessons=function(root){if(state.lesson.index!==null&&state.lesson.index!==undefined)return lesson18(root);return v18OldMemberLessons(root)};window.renderMemberLessons=renderMemberLessons;
